walk-raaz:
I built the Raaz healthcare platform end-to-end: a React Native app, an Express/TypeScript API on 10+ Lambda services, and a Supabase database, now serving 55,000+ patients. I wired Razorpay, Shopify, Prozo, and Proship into one order pipeline with idempotent webhook handlers and Redis-backed queues so retries can't corrupt state. On top of that I built a real-time call-center system on Socket.io and DynamoDB that handles 200,000+ calls a month, and a clinical engine on Claude and Groq that cut consultation prep time by 70%. The hard part was making every integration recover cleanly from partial failure.
Here's the full picture.
